question: Which of the following Union territories has the lowest population density according to the 2011 census?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andaman and Nicobar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Population density**

 
 
• Population density is a **measurement of population per unit area or exceptionally unit volume.**
 
• It is a quantity of **type number density.**
 
• It is frequently applied to **living organisms, most of the time to humans.**
 
• It is a **key geographical term.**
 
• In simple terms, **population density refers to the number of people living in an area per square kilometre.**
 
 
 
• **Population Density of respective Union Territories**
 
 
• Daman and Diu - 2191
 
• Dadra and Nagar Haveli - 1809
 
• **Andaman and Nicobar - 46**
 
• **Puducherry - 2547**
 
 
 
• **According to the 2011 census, the Andaman and Nicobar Islands has the lowest population density of the following Union Territories**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Population density (persons per sq. km) by state**
 
• **Highest**
 
 
• **Bihar - 1106**
 
• West Bengal - 1028
 
• Kerala - 859
 
• Uttar Pradesh - 829
 
• Haryana - 573
 
 
 
• **Lowest**
 
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh - 17**
 
• Mizoram - 52
 
• Sikkim - 86
 
• Nagaland - 119
 
• Manipur - 122
